selection_rationale: Directly targets gap G2 by experimentally measuring the safety benefit of a concrete generate–validate–repair (G‑V‑R) pipeline versus direct LLM generation. The paired design yields a clear, falsifiable primary outcome (validator-pass rate difference), is computationally feasible within the stated budget, and maps tightly to CNSM NetOps reliability concerns—making it the strongest defensible short-paper study after repairs.
unresolved_uncertainties: Validator-oracle mismatch: deterministic validator may mark unconventional-but-safe configs as violations.
Dataset representativeness: public/config-example sourcing may not reflect production distribution (external validity).
Single-LLM / single-version dependence: results may not generalize across models/versions.
Human adjudication conflict with autonomy/reproducibility requirements unless fully specified or eliminated.
API rate limits, transient failures, and retry-policy interactions could bias paired comparisons.
Simulator/validator faithfulness to multi-vendor device semantics for some violation categories.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify the exact validator toolchain (software, versions) and publish rule-set files and validator code/config; include representative test-oracle examples.
Define task sourcing, sampling, and provenance procedure (sources, sanitization, training/held-out split) and publish the task manifest.
Fix model invocation details: provider, exact model identifier(s)/version, full prompt templates, temperature/seed schedule, number of calls per sample; snapshot and publish all raw model outputs.

Eliminate underspecified human adjudication: replace with pre-registered deterministic tie-breaker heuristics or, if human review is necessary, pre-register reviewer selection, blinding, rubric, and log every decision for reproducibility.

Pre-register retry and failure-handling policy: explicit rules for rate-limit retries, transient-failure classification, truncated-run handling, and how such cases are included/excluded in paired analyses; publish hash-signed execution logs.
Predefine exclusions and stopping rules for nonsensical or destructive LLM outputs and describe sandboxing/safety measures that prevent any real-device application during experiments.
